title: 中华人民共和国数据安全法
title_en: Data Security Law of the People's Republic of China
body: 为了规范数据处理活动，保障数据安全，保护个人、组织的合法权益，维护国家主权、安全和发展利益，制定本法。国家对个人信息保护、重要数据出境安全评估、数据处理者义务作出规定，建立数据分类分级保护制度，明确数据安全风险评估和跨境数据传输要求。

title: 中华人民共和国个人信息保护法
title_en: Personal Information Protection Law of the PRC
body: 为了保护个人信息权益，规范个人信息处理活动，促进个人信息合理利用，根据宪法制定本法。明确个人信息处理规则、敏感个人信息保护、数据出境安全评估、个人信息跨境提供的条件，要求处理者履行信息安全与数据保护义务。

title: 中华人民共和国网络安全法
body: 为了保障网络安全，维护网络空间主权和国家安全、社会公共利益，保护公民、法人和其他组织的合法权益，促进经济社会信息化健康发展，制定本法。规定网络运营者安全保护义务、个人信息保护、数据本地化存储、关键信息基础设施保护、网络安全审查制度。

title: General Data Protection Regulation
body: Regulation on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data. Establishes rules on personal data protection, data processing, cross border data transfer, data breach notification, privacy rights, and information security obligations for data controllers and processors.

title: California Consumer Privacy Act
body: An act to add privacy rights for California consumers relating to personal information. Establishes data protection, personal data, privacy, and information security obligations for businesses processing personal information, including data breach notification and the right to deletion of personal data.

title: Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados
body: This law provides for the processing of personal data, data protection, privacy, and information security. It establishes rules on personal information, cross border data transfer, data processing, and data breach obligations for data controllers in Brazil.

title: 中华人民共和国增值税法
title_en: Value Added Tax Law of the PRC
body: 为了规范增值税征收管理，制定本法。规定纳税义务人、税率、增值税抵扣、纳税申报、税收优惠政策、税务稽查程序。明确增值税税率结构、小规模纳税人标准、进项税额抵扣范围与转让定价相关税务处理。

title: 中华人民共和国企业所得税法实施条例
title_en: Corporate Income Tax Law Implementation Regulations
body: 根据企业所得税法制定本条例。明确企业所得税应纳税所得额计算、税率、税收优惠、税前扣除项目、转让定价调整、预提税征收、跨境税收协定适用与税务稽查程序。

title: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act
body: An Act to provide for reconciliation pursuant to titles II and V of the concurrent resolution on the budget for fiscal year 2018. Reform corporate income tax, reduce tax rate, modify deduction rules, change transfer pricing, international tax provisions, withholding tax, and tax treaty interactions.

title: Directive on Mandatory Disclosure of Reportable Cross-Border Arrangements
body: Council Directive requiring intermediaries to disclose reportable cross-border arrangements. Focuses on tax avoidance, transfer pricing, tax treaty abuse, withholding tax, and tax audit transparency. Taxpayers and intermediaries must report aggressive tax planning arrangements.

title: 中华人民共和国证券法（修订）
body: 为了规范证券发行和交易行为，保护投资者合法权益，维护社会经济秩序和社会公共利益，制定本法。规定证券发行注册制、信息披露义务、上市公司收购、内幕交易禁止、证券监管、交易所自律管理、并购重组与招股说明书要求。

title: 中华人民共和国商业银行法（修订）
title_en: Commercial Banking Law of the PRC (Revised)
body: 为了保护商业银行、存款人和其他客户的合法权益，规范商业银行的行为，制定本法。规定商业银行设立、资本充足率、银行业监管、风险管理和反洗钱义务、金融衍生品业务、信息披露与资本市场监管要求。

title: Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act
body: An Act to promote the financial stability of the United States by improving accountability and transparency in the financial system. Reforms banking regulation, derivatives, securities, capital market, insurance, and establishes anti money laundering (AML) and disclosure obligations for financial institutions.

title: Markets in Financial Instruments Directive II
body: Directive on markets in financial instruments. Regulates securities, capital market, derivatives, investment services, exchange trading, disclosure, and investor protection in financial markets. Strengthens regulation of financial intermediaries and transparent pricing.

title: Financial Services and Markets Act
body: An Act to regulate financial services and markets. Establishes the FCA regulation framework for banking, securities, insurance, investment, and capital market activities. Covers disclosure, market abuse, anti money laundering, and exchange oversight in the United Kingdom.

title: 中华人民共和国环境保护法（修订）
title_en: Environmental Protection Law of the PRC (Revised)
body: 为保护和改善环境，防治污染和其他公害，保障公众健康，推进生态文明建设，促进经济社会可持续发展，制定本法。规定排污许可、环境影响评价（环评）、污染排放标准、碳排放控制、生态保护与绿色发展要求。

title: 碳排放权交易管理办法（试行）
title_en: Measures for Carbon Emission Trading Management
body: 为落实碳达峰碳中和目标，规范温室气体排放与碳排放权交易，制定本办法。规定重点排放单位碳排放报告与核查、碳配额分配与清缴、温室气体（GHG）减排、能耗双控与绿色低碳发展要求。

title: Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive
body: Directive on corporate sustainability reporting. Extends ESG disclosure, environmental, climate, carbon emission, greenhouse gas (GHG), net zero, and sustainability reporting obligations for large companies. Strengthens green and sustainable finance transparency.

title: Clean Air Act
body: An Act to improve, strengthen, and accelerate programs for the prevention and abatement of air pollution. Regulates environmental emissions, pollution, greenhouse gas (GHG), climate, carbon emission, and energy consumption standards for industrial facilities.

title: 中华人民共和国劳动法
body: 为了保护劳动者的合法权益，调整劳动关系，建立和维护适应社会主义市场经济的劳动制度，制定本法。规定劳动合同、工资薪酬、工时与加班、社会保险与社保、劳动保护、最低工资、雇佣与解雇、劳动争议处理。

title: 中华人民共和国劳动合同法
title_en: Employment Contract Law of the PRC
body: 为了规范劳动关系，明确劳动合同制度，保护劳动者权益，制定本法。规定劳动合同订立与解除、劳务派遣、试用期、经济补偿、工时加班、工资薪酬、社会保险、最低工资标准与劳动保护。

title: Working Time Directive
body: Directive concerning certain aspects of the organization of working time. Sets labor rules on maximum working time, overtime, rest periods, annual leave, night work, and labor protection for workers and employees in the European Union.

title: Fair Labor Standards Act
body: An Act to provide for the establishment of fair labor standards in employments engaged in commerce. Establishes minimum wage, overtime pay, working time, recordkeeping, and child labor standards for employees and workers in the United States.

title: 中华人民共和国反垄断法（修订）
body: 为了预防和制止垄断行为，保护市场公平竞争，提高经济运行效率，制定本法。规定垄断协议禁止、滥用市场支配地位、经营者集中申报与审查、价格垄断、平台经济反垄断、不正当竞争与公平竞争审查。

title: Sherman Antitrust Act
body: An Act to protect trade and commerce against unlawful restraints and monopolies. Prohibits antitrust violations, monopoly, cartel, price monopoly, abuse of dominant market position, unfair competition, and merger review for anticompetitive conduct.

title: Digital Markets Act
body: Regulation on contestable and fair markets in the digital sector. Targets antitrust, monopoly, platform economy, gatekeepers, abuse of dominant position, unfair competition, fair competition, and merger review for digital markets in the European Union.

title: 企业会计准则——基本准则
title_en: Accounting Standard for Business Enterprises - Basic Standard
body: 为了规范企业会计确认、计量和报告行为，保证会计信息质量，制定本准则。规定财务报告目标、会计要素确认、公允价值计量、收入确认、金融工具、减值、租赁、合并报表、股份支付、会计政策与会计估计、信息披露要求。

title: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers
body: International Financial Reporting Standard on revenue recognition. Establishes accounting principles for revenue, financial statement disclosure, accounting policy, fair value, contract, performance obligation, and consolidated reporting requirements for enterprises.

title: FASB Accounting Standards Update
body: Accounting standards update improving income tax disclosure. Amends GAAP accounting, financial report, financial statement, disclosure, accounting policy, and tax-related reporting requirements for enterprises and listed companies.

title: 数据出境安全评估办法
title_en: Measures for Security Assessment of Outbound Data Transfer
body: 为了规范数据出境活动，保护个人信息权益和数据安全，制定本办法。规定数据处理者向境外提供数据的跨境数据传输安全评估、重要数据出境、个人信息出境、数据合规与信息安全审查要求。
agency: 国家互联网信息办公室

title: 中华人民共和国反洗钱法
title_en: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the PRC
body: 为了预防洗钱活动，维护金融秩序，制定本法。规定金融机构反洗钱（AML）义务、客户身份识别、大额和可疑交易报告、反洗钱监管、银行业与证券业合规、信息披露与资本市场监管要求。

title: Fourth Anti-Money Laundering Directive
body: Directive on the prevention of the use of the financial system for money laundering. Establishes anti money laundering (AML) obligations, customer due diligence, beneficial ownership disclosure, banking regulation, securities, and financial supervision requirements.
